sections.description: Full-coverage Contact Form 7 abilities for MCP. Form CRUD, form tags, mail templates, messages, additional settings, config validation, status and test submission.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Security audit: SENSITIVE_PATTERN's bare auth substring was matching author-related field names, causing unnecessary over-redaction. Narrowed to authoriz — still catches authorization, no longer catches author. No other findings on this bridge's write surface (WPCF7_ContactForm::save() already protects its own writes).

1.0.2

  • Distribution pipeline test release — no functional changes.

1.0.1

  • Added self-hosted update checker (plugin-update-checker, vendored).
  • Added GPLv2-or-later license header.
  • Updated Plugin URI to the new public monorepo.
